facts.fact: NPC, NIMC, UNICEF and ALGON agreed a compact for ward-level static points issuing birth certificates and NINs to under-fives, with data interoperability, in eleven pilot states.
facts.system: Ward-level birth registration and NIN enrolment points

NGA.note: No enrolment count or share given.

facts.fact: NPC, NIMC, UNICEF and ALGON adopted a work plan for phased rollout in eleven pilot states of ward-level points giving under-fives a birth certificate and a National Identification Number.
facts.system: Under-five birth registration and NIN enrolment initiative
